source.label: CrowdStrike FY2026 Form 10-K (fiscal year ended Jan 31, 2026), Item 2 Properties
source.quote: Our principal executive offices occupy approximately 47,618 square feet in Austin, Texas under a lease that expires in 2030.

notes: CrowdStrike publishes very little about where it operates. The FY2026 10-K (fiscal year ended Jan 31, 2026) gives 10,698 full-time employees with no country or state split, describes a deliberately distributed workforce ('the ability to work remotely or in a hybrid arrangement is a deliberate strategy'), and names only its Austin headquarters, adding that it leases offices "in various locations throughout the United States as well as office space in a number of countries in Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia-Pacific region". The only geographic non-revenue figure is property and equipment plus right-of-use assets, recorded in $ thousands as filed; 'Other countries' ($84,222 thousand) is a residual and is not shown. No state-level figures appear in the 10-K; no company impact report was found beyond it.
